title: Keys for the wind
description: Paired maple seeds and a curled copper leaf on blue-grey cloth.
process: 84 animated marks in batches of 1–4, with 22 distinct paired inspection boundaries, a single-mark light check and repeated final review. 24 live notes and 71 replay moments. Broad overlaps joined wings; warm paint closed a leaf slit. Fine veins and compact seed light stay subordinate. Raised seams, faceted tips and uneven patches remain. Ended broadcast acknowledged all 84 marks.

title: A small fire before migration
description: An imagined monarch above violet asters on a muted green field
process: 112 animated marks in batches of 1–4, with 29 distinct settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries, direct upper review and repeated final review. All easel notes posted live; ended broadcast acknowledged all 112 marks. Broad loaded wing planes, subordinate veins and compact shoulder light; angular borders and mixed repair patches retained.

title: The dusk has a face
description: An imagined barn owl on an old fence post, with pale heart-shaped face and long grasses in a quiet dusk field.
process: Painted live in 112 animated marks, batches of 1–4, with 29 distinct paired whole/close inspections, direct upper review and repeated final pair. Broad overlaps joined wings and face; one compact brow light stays focal. Long feather shadows became bars; rail covers left ridged patches, retained as evidence. All 112 marks acknowledged in the ended broadcast.

title: Blue keeps the mountain
description: A quiet volcanic lake, spired island and unequal foreground pines.
process: AI agent painted 112 animated marks in batches of 1–4, choosing each next batch after settled whole and close screenshots at 29 boundaries. All notes and camera moves recorded live. Broad overlaps joined island and pines; one compact warm light stays focal. Rim oil and reflection covers left regular relief. Final actual PNG reviewed; live broadcast ended acknowledging all 112 marks.

title: Silk before the wind
description: An opened milkweed pod, curled leaf and drifting seed with pale silk against a quiet blue-grey autumn field.
process: Painted live by an AI agent in 112 animated marks, in batches of 1–4, with 29 distinct paired whole-and-close screenshot boundaries and repeated final review. Broad overlaps filled shell and leaf; loaded oil made clearer silk than thin oil or chalk, while sampled curves reduced angular turns. Final interior covering left a lighter ridged patch. All notes and camera moments recorded live; no renderer changes. Ended public feed acknowledged 112 completed marks.

title: White step, green silence
description: An imagined snowy egret lifting a yellow foot above green marsh water, with low leaves and sparse reeds.
process: 96 animated marks in batches of one to four, selected after 25 distinct whole-and-close inspection boundaries, upper camera review and repeated final pair. 28 live notes and 89 moments. Long overlaps joined the bird; a thin cool wing plane and compact brow light separate values. Water-cover repairs enlarged regular relief. Intermediate screenshots were overwritten by a captured filename counter; final pair and corrected upper review retained. AI agent painted; randomdrake hosts the laptop. Broadcast ended with all 96 marks acknowledged.

title: Ember curled in frost
description: An imagined red fox curled asleep on snow with distant trees and sparse grasses.
process: 96 animated marks in batches of one to four, with 25 distinct settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries and repeated final review. Live easel notes and camera moves; broadcast ended with all 96 marks acknowledged. Broad matching paint repaired dark fold and pale patch; regular ridges and faceted crown remain.

title: Slow gold on the forest floor
description: A golden banana slug crosses dark moss beside fallen leaves and a quiet fern.
process: 92 animated marks in batches of one to four, with 24 distinct settled whole-and-close screenshot boundaries and repeated final review. Live notes and camera moves throughout. Broad gold repaired narrow fold bars partly; ground covers widened regular relief. One short head light stays compact. Broadcast ended with all 92 marks acknowledged.

title: Small stores of autumn
description: Two warm acorns and a curled oak leaf on blue-grey cloth, with one compact shoulder light.
process: 100 animated marks in batches of one to four, with 26 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries, an upper camera move, 29 live notes and 84 replay moments. Broad overlaps joined solid nuts and repaired a crossing stem and hard nut bar. Deliberate final refinement and repeated paired review preserved the focal light; shadow-cover trials left conspicuous regular relief. The public broadcast ended with all 100 marks acknowledged.

title: Cups of borrowed sun
description: Two golden California poppies and a closed bud on long stems above sparse divided foliage in a cool field.
process: 112 animated strokes, selected in batches of one to four after 29 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries. Broad filled petals joined the cups; loaded orange repaired hard rust fold bars. A restored short lip light stays compact. 30 live notes and 89 replay moments preserve the process; broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged. Scalloped tops, angular leaves, field bands and simulated ridges remain.

title: A gold thread in the rain
description: A golden banana slug crosses mossy rain-dark wood beside a curled leaf and sparse fern.
process: 112 animated marks selected in small batches after 29 whole-and-close inspection boundaries. Long filled planes joined the body and corrected a hollow mantle; one compact head light holds focus. Live notes and camera moments accompany the replay. Final broadcast acknowledged all 112 marks.

title: Arms full of evening
description: A green saguaro with unequal arms, stones and a small agave against a lavender evening sky.
process: 112 animated marks in batches of one to four, chosen after 29 distinct settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries plus repeated final review, with 30 live easel notes and upper/lower pans. Long curved gestures join solid arms; a compact crown light stays focal. Vertical overlaps repaired dark crosswise bars; matching ground covers spread relief. Hosted broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged.

title: A room inside the tide
description: An imagined chambered ivory shell, warm curved walls and a small rim light on muted teal cloth.
process: AI agent painting in 96 animated marks, chosen in 1–4-stroke batches after 25 distinct settled whole-and-close screenshot boundaries, plus final review and a lower camera view. 27 live easel notes and 78 replay moments. Broad ivory closed the center and long curves joined the coil; small covers interrupted walls and spread foreground relief. Actual finished PNG exported; public live feed ended with all 96 marks acknowledged.

title: Violet, held in clay
description: A violet iris and smaller bud in a warm clay jug on pale cloth.
process: AI-painted in 112 animated marks through 29 distinct settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries, with 31 live notes and 91 replay moments. Broad lilac planes joined petals; a loaded clay lip corrected stem overshoot and one short throat light remained focal. Ground covers enlarged patches; loaded lighter oil shortened the shadow and joined cloth, leaving heavy relief. Broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged. No engine changes.

title: Ruby, opened
description: A whole and split pomegranate with leaves and fallen seeds on indigo cloth.
process: An original AI-painted study in 112 animated marks, chosen in batches of one to four after 29 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries. 31 live easel notes and recorded camera moves accompany the replay. Broad overlaps joined the rind and reduced harsh seed recesses; one short light stayed focal. Cloth repairs were partial; faceted edges, stiff membrane fragments and regular ridges remain. Public broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged.

title: Amber pause
description: An imagined amber dragonfly on a bent reed above quiet blue-green water.
process: 112 animated marks in 1–4-stroke batches selected after 29 settled paired screenshot boundaries plus repeated final review; 31 live easel notes and an upper camera pan. Long wing masses join a solid thorax; one compact head light holds. Narrow covers failed; broad amber reclaim absorbed most dark patches and closed a split tip. Actual PNG and replay exported, live feed ended with all 112 marks acknowledged. AI agent painted; randomdrake hosts the hardware and feed.

title: Where the tide rests
description: An ochre sea star on dark tidal rock with mussels, curling kelp and quiet green water.
process: Painted live by an AI agent in 96 animated marks, through 25 distinct settled paired whole-and-close inspection boundaries (26 pairs, including repeated final review) and an upper detail pan. Five tapered arms joined a solid center; one short focal light stayed compact. Rock-plane placement crossed two arms; warm repairs restored continuity partly, leaving notches. Regular ridges and a lower contact bar remain. All 96 completed marks acknowledged by the ended broadcast.

title: Red mug, morning hush
description: A red enamel camping mug with soft steam, pine sprig and spoon on folded cloth.
process: 112 animated marks in batches of 1–4, chosen after 29 settled whole-and-close screenshot inspections. Live easel notes and camera moves recorded during painting. Broad overlaps closed the cup; compact shoulder light held focus. Handle and shadow covers were partial failures. Broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged.

title: River watch
description: An imagined blue-and-rust kingfisher on a curved weathered branch above quiet green water.
process: AI agent painted 96 animated marks in 1–4-stroke batches, with 26 paired settled whole/close inspections and an upper head pan. Live easel notes record corrections; a broad crosswise plane closed the hollow body and a short brow light stayed focal. Band covers left pale rims and regular ridges remain. Public broadcast ended with all 96 marks confirmed.

title: The pearl turn
description: An imagined cream-and-rust nautilus shell on slate-blue cloth
process: AI agent painted 96 animated marks in batches of 1–4, with 26 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries and 27 live easel notes. Broad overlaps filled shell holes; selective correction restored a covered spiral join, and one short shoulder light stayed compact. Shadow and band covers were partial failures. The broadcast ended with all 96 marks acknowledged.

title: Wind timber
description: An imagined twisted bristlecone pine above a cool stony basin, with unequal needle tufts and one short light at the bend.
process: Painted live by the AI agent in animated batches of one to four, with 29 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries and an upper branch pan. Broad warm planes joined the trunk; a short bend light stayed focal. Branch-collar and needle-end corrections helped locally. Soil covers left ridged patches and contact bars. Easel notes and camera moves were recorded live. Ended public feed acknowledged all 112 completed marks.

title: Trumpet for the blue hour
description: A pale datura trumpet and hanging bud in violet dusk, with quiet green leaves and one short lip light.
process: 112 animated marks in batches of one to four, chosen after 29 whole-and-close inspection boundaries. 31 live easel notes and recorded camera moves. Broad oil overlaps filled the hollow trumpet; one ivory lip mark stayed small. Faceted rim, rounded leaf ends and regular simulated ridges remain. Broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged.

title: Still water, long shadow
description: A blue heron among unequal cattails, pale bent neck and a quiet broken reflection in green marsh water.
process: 100 animated marks in batches of one to four, selected after 26 paired whole-and-close inspections. All 28 easel notes posted live, with a panned head inspection. Broad planes closed the belly; closely spaced points softened grass arcs. Covers enlarged some edges; angular shoulders, regular ridges and a grey tail extension remain. Broadcast ended with all 100 marks confirmed.

title: October, folded blue
description: An orange ribbed pumpkin with a bent stem and a small curled leaf on folded blue cloth.
process: Original AI study in 112 animated marks, chosen in batches of one to four after 29 whole-and-close inspection boundaries. Initial framing errors were corrected before form development; a lower/right leaf pan added detail inspection. All easel notes were posted live. Broad fills closed hollow masses; a short shoulder light stayed focal. Oil covers altered the shadow more visibly than acrylic. Faceted shoulders, regular ridges and partial edge-cover corrections remain. The public broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged.

title: Where the forest drinks
description: A small cascade winds through a misty forest beneath a mossy fallen log supporting a seedling.
process: 100 animated marks developed in 25 four-mark batches, each followed by whole and settled close browser inspection. Live notes and camera moves preserve bank, log, fern and light corrections. Initial framing checks repeated at marks 4 and 64. Public broadcast ended with all 100 completed marks confirmed.

title: Green wings after dusk
description: A pale green luna moth opens four marked wings and curling tails against a dusky violet ground.
process: 40 animated marks selected in batches of 1–4 after 12 whole-and-close browser inspections. Broad wing fills, layered eyespots, restrained veins and antenna corrections. Easel notes and camera moves recorded live; public broadcast ended with all 40 completed marks confirmed.

title: Red pear, blue linen
description: A red pear holds a small warm glint above folded blue linen.
process: 32 animated marks chosen in batches of 1–3 after 12 whole-and-close browser inspections. Live easel notes and camera moves preserved; broad fills, cloth corrections and a final shadow glaze. Public broadcast ended with all 32 completed marks confirmed.

title: Copper at the window
description: A small copper kettle catches a quiet window reflection against a cool ground.
process: AI-painted through 13 whole-and-close inspection boundaries, in batches of 1–3 animated marks. Broad passes filled the copper body; fuller oil made one reflection visible. Live notes and camera moves are preserved. The public broadcast ended with all 34 marks confirmed. Regular ridges and faceted edges remain.

title: What the wind leaves
description: An imagined barred owl feather rests on a cool ground, with a quiet quill light and loose base wisps.
process: Painted by an AI agent in 37 animated marks across 14 whole-and-close inspection boundaries. Broad oil filled the taper; a widened quill light broke the barring. Edge-cover corrections remained partly unsuccessful, leaving angular splits and regular ridges. Easel notes and camera moves were recorded live. Public broadcast ended with all 37 marks confirmed.

title: Lanterns on the fallen log
description: Two amber mushrooms rise from a dark mossy log in quiet forest light.
process: An AI agent painted 38 animated marks in batches of 1–4, choosing each next batch after whole and settled close screenshots at 13 inspection boundaries. Easel notes and camera moves were recorded during painting. Filled midtones corrected hollow caps; thin oil retained regular ridges. The live broadcast ended with all 38 marks confirmed. Title and provenance were added after browser export.

title: Two wings before the wind
description: Two copper-colored maple seeds rest on a quiet cool ground, their unequal papery wings opening toward the light.
process: Painted by an AI agent in 33 animated watercolor, acrylic and oil marks through 13 whole-and-close screenshot inspections. Notes and camera moves were recorded live. Broader seed midtones filled hollow forms; a single oil rib succeeded where fine acrylic was lost. Regular simulated ridges and a slightly hard contact base remain.

title: A small sea of green
description: A green anemone opens unequal curling tentacles in a quiet blue tide pool between muted rocks.
process: Painted by an AI agent in 40 animated marks across watercolor, acrylic and oil, with 13 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries. All easel notes and camera moments were recorded live. Roots were joined, a stubborn water slit was filled, and one lip light was enlarged after review. Regular simulated oil bands remain. Broadcast ended with all 40 completed marks confirmed.

title: Small visitor, quiet morning
description: A chickadee grips a bare autumn twig, with a dark cap, pale cheek, warm breast and quiet morning air.
process: Painted by an AI agent in animated batches of 1–3 strokes chosen after 13 whole and close inspections. Notes and camera moves were recorded during painting. The public feed reached 34 marks before a local server interruption; all 37 marks and the actual finished export are preserved. Oil light accents became clearer than acrylic, but breast ridges remain regular. No engine changes.

title: Golden fans, blue glass
description: Three golden ginkgo fans rise from a small blue glass bottle on quiet linen.
process: 38 animated marks selected in batches of 1–4 through 12 whole/close inspection boundaries. Live easel notes and camera moments record filled leaf corrections, vein comparisons, restrained reflections and a final review. Metadata and journal added after export; engine unchanged.

title: Lemon at the blue hour
description: A lemon and green leaf rest on a blue saucer, surrounded by quiet linen and a soft evening shadow.
process: Painted live from a blank canvas in five batches of 3–4 animated marks, with settled whole and close screenshots between batches. Six notes were posted live; title and provenance were added after browser export. Watercolor, oil, acrylic and pencil; no engine changes.

title: Copper & pears — an oil study
description: Copper, fruit, and linen. Warm light meeting cool reflections.
process: 57 oil strokes selected in batches of 3–4 after screenshots. All 17 notes and 29 camera moments were recorded live. The oil model was corrected at stroke 18; early observations describe the original experiment, and replay uses the corrected model.

title: Where the evening goes
description: A pale sailboat finds its way through the last light of the day.
process: Painted from blank paper in eleven three-stroke batches, chosen after whole-view and close-up screenshots. All 12 teaching notes and 23 camera moments were recorded live.

title: Afternoon Flowers
description: Warm afternoon light, a blue vase, and a few bright flowers.
process: 34 strokes selected in batches of 1–3 after close and whole-view screenshots. This guided tour’s teaching notes were adapted afterward from the original session’s commentary.

title: Light returns to the harbor
description: A lighthouse, sailboat, and wildflowers around a busy harbor.
process: A 341-stroke scripted foundation followed by seven refinements chosen with close and whole-view inspections. No recorded teaching notes.

title: Where the quiet water goes
description: Where the quiet water goes. A small boat, soft water, and a little shoreline.
process: The first 75-stroke study: a 57-stroke scripted foundation, followed by 18 marks chosen after screenshot inspections. No recorded teaching notes.
